decisions.decision: Build all of T-229 now. 1) Add isPlaceholderEmail(email) to cloud/src/util.ts. It refuses example.com, example.net and example.org (including subdomains), plus any address ending in .test, .invalid, .localhost or .example. 2) Call it in issue() in cloud/src/calendar.ts (POST /cal/issue), in POST /intake in cloud/src/live.ts and in the admin add form in cloud/src/index.ts. On a match, reply with the same status and body shape as a normal sign-up, but create no attendee and no session_sync row. Export the helper for the T-234 Tantra import. 3) Add an example.com refusal check to app/scripts/probe-calendar-feeds.mjs. Run it against vendor-sim (SIM_PORT=8902) plus wrangler dev until it passes. 4) Commit, push main, deploy the Worker. 5) Through the admin API, PATCH /admin/api/attendees/5 {test:true} using the key in ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key. Then confirm in GET /admin/api/calendar that no failed Zoom rows remain for non-test attendees. Log the commit, Worker version and probe output, then move to review for Nelbin and Aquila.
